extracted.name: Air fryer apple pie bites
extracted.description: I could not believe this is going to be my new addiction in the future, eating and making apple pie bites. Fresh homemade apple pie crust also Air fryer made it so easier and faster process to fry the pie, this pie is very simple and good for you to serve it as a small dessert to be enjoyed with your family and company.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup cold flaky butter (cold but not frozen)
instruction_lines: Combined and knead all ingredients to make pie crust dough, after well combined as a good dough wrap and let it rest 30 mins in the refrigerator
Combine all ingredients for apple filling, let sit until the pie crust dough is ready
After 30 mins pie crust is ready, pad it with the rolling pin and cut it with 3inch diameter round cookie cutters (I made it into 25 to 30 pcs crust)
Start fill the pie crust with the apple, fold it and pad it using fork to lock each side of the crust
Preheat airfreight on 350 degrees, grease it with canola oil and place about 8-10 pie and coat each pie using olive oil or spray using canola oil
20 mins fry on the airfryer, flip 10 mins each side
Apple pie bites is ready in 20 mins, let cool and ready to be serve
